fix(dart): normalize high-bit-depth image processing

Summary:
- normalize Atkinson inputs into a stable uint8 RGBA buffer before
  dithering and keep diffusion bounded to valid neighbors
- rewrite Pbita raw bit packing around uint8 normalization, luminance
  thresholding, and explicit byte/bit indexing
- add regression tests that cover uint16 inputs for both algorithm paths

Rationale:
- iOS image decode paths can surface non-uint8 images, which caused the
  previous code to misread thresholds and emit blank or all-white output
- manual Atkinson normalization avoids the palette conversion crash that
  the image package can trigger on some intermediate images

Tests:
- cd dart/algorithms/dithering && dart test
- cd dart/algorithms/imageb && dart test
